column1: # B1053 (#373): open the Options window and take one still per tab, in XML
# tab order. MEASURED on lane 5 (1280x1024 Xorg, crop +0+30): the window
# opens at its INI position -- defaults.ini [OptionsWindow] XPos1280x1024=95
# YPos1280x1024=97 (root 95,127), NOT the XML <absolute> Location (90,47) and
# NOT fable's centred anchor (the flagged deviation the side-by-side records).
# The tab strip is 28px below the window top (root y 155..177, centre 166).
# The oracle sizes each tab to its TabText (General is widest); the click x's
# come from the General still's measured strip (refactor/B1053/README.md
# "Tab strip"), each landing mid-tab with >= 15px of clearance.
